title: Use an uploaded character sheet as a strict visual reference by explicitly…
content:
Use an uploaded character sheet as a strict visual reference by explicitly stating “Use uploaded character sheet as strict visual reference” and detailing key identifiers (hair, glasses, scar, robe, wand hand) to lock character consistency.

Force nonstop action by adding continuous-motion constraints like “Never stops moving — sprinting, diving, rolling, firing constantly” and “never static never slow.”

Control pacing and shot progression by writing a timestamped beat sheet (e.g., 0:00–0:15) with specific actions per segment to guide scene-to-scene continuity.

Keep the model from starting slow by specifying “0:00–0:01 — Already mid-fight” to begin in medias res.

Drive audio behavior by explicitly prompting an “AUDIO” section with requirements like “loud from frame one,” “every spell synced to the beat,” and “rain constant throughout.”

Increase stylistic fidelity by stacking precise style tags (e.g., “cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime,” “semi-realistic CGI,” “hand-painted textures,” “Unreal Engine quality,” “film grain”) and adding negative constraints (“not cartoon not Disney not Pixar”).

es.content:
Usa una hoja de personaje subida como referencia visual estricta, indicando explícitamente “Use uploaded character sheet as strict visual reference” y detallando los identificadores clave (cabello, gafas, cicatriz, túnica, mano con la varita) para fijar la coherencia del personaje.

Fuerza una acción ininterrumpida añadiendo restricciones de movimiento continuo como “Never stops moving — sprinting, diving, rolling, firing constantly” y “never static never slow.”

Controla el ritmo y la progresión de los planos escribiendo una hoja de ritmo con marcas de tiempo (p. ej., 0:00–0:15) y acciones específicas por segmento para guiar la continuidad de escena a escena.

Evita que el modelo empiece lento especificando “0:00–0:01 — Already mid-fight” para comenzar in medias res.

Dirige el comportamiento del audio indicando explícitamente una sección “AUDIO” con requisitos como “loud from frame one,” “every spell synced to the beat,” y “rain constant throughout.”

Aumenta la fidelidad estilística combinando etiquetas de estilo precisas (p. ej., “cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime,” “semi-realistic CGI,” “hand-painted textures,” “Unreal Engine quality,” “film grain”) y añadiendo restricciones negativas (“not cartoon not Disney not Pixar”).

fr.content:
Utilisez une character sheet téléversée comme référence visuelle stricte en indiquant explicitement « Use uploaded character sheet as strict visual reference » et en détaillant les identifiants clés (cheveux, lunettes, cicatrice, robe, main tenant la baguette) afin de verrouiller la cohérence du personnage.

Imposez une action ininterrompue en ajoutant des contraintes de mouvement continu comme « Never stops moving — sprinting, diving, rolling, firing constantly » et « never static never slow ».

Contrôlez le rythme et la progression des plans en rédigeant un beat sheet horodaté (par ex. 0:00–0:15) avec des actions précises pour chaque segment afin de guider la continuité de scène en scène.

Évitez que le modèle commence lentement en spécifiant « 0:00–0:01 — Already mid-fight » pour commencer in medias res.

Pilotez le comportement audio en demandant explicitement une section « AUDIO » avec des exigences comme « loud from frame one », « every spell synced to the beat » et « rain constant throughout ».

Renforcez la fidélité stylistique en empilant des tags de style précis (par ex. « cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime », « semi-realistic CGI », « hand-painted textures », « Unreal Engine quality », « film grain ») et en ajoutant des contraintes négatives (« not cartoon not Disney not Pixar »).

ja.content:
アップロードしたキャラクターシートを厳密なビジュアル参照として使うために、明示的に「Use uploaded character sheet as strict visual reference」と記述し、髪、メガネ、傷、ローブ、杖を持つ手などの主要な識別要素を詳しく指定して、キャラクターの一貫性を固定します。

「Never stops moving — sprinting, diving, rolling, firing constantly」や「never static never slow」のような連続動作の制約を追加して、絶え間ないアクションを強制します。

タイムスタンプ付きのビートシート（例: 0:00–0:15）を作成し、各区間ごとに具体的なアクションを記述して、シーン間の連続性を導くことで、ペース配分とショットの進行を制御します。

「0:00–0:01 — Already mid-fight」と指定して、冒頭からスロースタートにならないようにし、in medias res で始めます。

「AUDIO」セクションを明示的にプロンプトし、「loud from frame one」「every spell synced to the beat」「rain constant throughout」のような要件を入れて、音響の挙動を制御します。

「cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime」「semi-realistic CGI」「hand-painted textures」「Unreal Engine quality」「film grain」などの精密なスタイルタグを重ね、さらに「not cartoon not Disney not Pixar」といったネガティブ制約を加えることで、スタイルの忠実度を高めます。

ko.content:
업로드한 캐릭터 시트를 엄격한 시각적 기준으로 사용하도록, “Use uploaded character sheet as strict visual reference”라고 명시하고, 캐릭터 일관성을 고정하기 위해 핵심 식별 요소(머리카락, 안경, 흉터, 로브, 지팡이를 쥔 손)를 구체적으로 적는다.

“Never stops moving — sprinting, diving, rolling, firing constantly”와 “never static never slow” 같은 연속 동작 제약을 추가해, 멈추지 않는 액션을 강제한다.

타임스탬프가 포함된 비트 시트(예: 0:00–0:15)를 작성하고, 각 구간별로 구체적인 행동을 넣어 장면 간 연속성을 유도함으로써 페이싱과 샷 진행을 제어한다.

“0:00–0:01 — Already mid-fight”라고 지정해 시작을 in medias res로 설정함으로써, 모델이 느리게 시작하지 않도록 한다.

“AUDIO” 섹션을 명시적으로 프롬프트에 넣고, “loud from frame one,” “every spell synced to the beat,” “rain constant throughout” 같은 요구사항을 추가해 오디오 동작을 유도한다.

정확한 스타일 태그를 겹겹이 쌓아 스타일 충실도를 높이고(예: “cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime,” “semi-realistic CGI,” “hand-painted textures,” “Unreal Engine quality,” “film grain”), 부정 제약(“not cartoon not Disney not Pixar”)을 추가한다.

pt.content:
Use uma ficha de personagem enviada como referência visual rigorosa, declarando explicitamente “Use uploaded character sheet as strict visual reference” e detalhando identificadores-chave (cabelo, óculos, cicatriz, robe, mão da varinha) para travar a consistência do personagem.

Force ação ininterrupta adicionando restrições de movimento contínuo como “Never stops moving — sprinting, diving, rolling, firing constantly” e “never static never slow.”

Controle o ritmo e a progressão dos planos escrevendo uma beat sheet com timestamps (por exemplo, 0:00–0:15) e ações específicas por segmento para orientar a continuidade de cena a cena.

Impeça que o modelo comece devagar especificando “0:00–0:01 — Already mid-fight” para começar in medias res.

Conduza o comportamento do áudio promptando explicitamente uma seção “AUDIO” com requisitos como “loud from frame one,” “every spell synced to the beat,” e “rain constant throughout.”

Aumente a fidelidade estilística empilhando tags de estilo precisas (por exemplo, “cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime,” “semi-realistic CGI,” “hand-painted textures,” “Unreal Engine quality,” “film grain”) e adicionando restrições negativas (“not cartoon not Disney not Pixar”).

zh.content:
使用上传的角色设定表作为严格的视觉参考，明确写出“Use uploaded character sheet as strict visual reference”，并详细列出关键识别特征（头发、眼镜、伤疤、长袍、魔杖手），以锁定角色一致性。

通过加入持续运动约束来强制不停动作，例如“Never stops moving — sprinting, diving, rolling, firing constantly”和“never static never slow”。

通过编写带时间戳的节拍表（例如 0:00–0:15），并为每个片段指定具体动作，来控制节奏和镜头推进，从而引导场景之间的连贯性。

通过指定“0:00–0:01 — Already mid-fight”来让模型不要从慢节奏开始，而是直接从动作中段切入（in medias res）。

通过明确提示一个“AUDIO”部分来驱动音频行为，并加入诸如“loud from frame one”、“every spell synced to the beat”和“rain constant throughout”之类的要求。

通过叠加精确的风格标签（例如“cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime”、“semi-realistic CGI”、“hand-painted textures”、“Unreal Engine quality”、“film grain”）并添加负面约束（“not cartoon not Disney not Pixar”），来提升风格保真度。
